mapper.select: SELECT tdm54_chck_insuff_id AS chck_insuff_id , tdm54_company_id AS company_id , tdm54_role_id AS role_id , tdm54_org_id AS org_id , TO_CHAR(tdm54_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date , TO_CHAR(tdm54_due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS due_date , tdm54_plan_action_emp_id AS plan_action_emp_id , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm54_plan_action_emp_id) AS plan_action_emp_name , tdm54_action_nm AS action_name , tdm54_action_plan AS action_plan , tdm54_plan_reg_emp_id AS plan_reg_emp_id , tdm54_status_cd AS status_code , tdm54_chck_manl_id AS chck_manl_id , tdm54_occ_ym AS occ_ym FROM tdm54_chck_insuff WHERE tdm54_chck_manl_id = #{chckManlId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm54_chck_insuff ( tdm54_chck_insuff_id, tdm54_company_id, tdm54_role_id, tdm54_org_id, tdm54_reg_date, tdm54_due_date, tdm54_plan_action_emp_id, tdm54_action_nm, tdm54_action_plan, tdm54_plan_reg_emp_id, tdm54_status_cd, tdm54_chck_manl_id, tdm54_occ_ym, tdm54_upd_nm, tdm54_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{chckInsuffId}, #{companyId}, #{roleId}, #{orgId}, CAST(#{req.regDate} AS date), CAST(#{req.dueDate} AS date), #{req.planActionEmpId}, #{req.actionName}, #{req.actionPlan}, #{planRegEmpId}, #{statusCode}, #{req.chckManlId}, #{occYm}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
mapper.sql: t.tdm54_chck_insuff_id AS chck_insuff_id , t.tdm54_chck_manl_id AS chck_manl_id , t.tdm54_company_id AS company_id , t.tdm54_role_id AS role_id , t.tdm54_org_id AS org_id , t.tdm54_check_ym AS check_ym , TO_CHAR(t.tdm54_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date , t.tdm54_role_nm AS role_name , t.tdm54_org_nm AS org_name , t.tdm54_action_nm AS action_name , t.tdm54_action_plan AS action_plan , t.tdm54_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('TdmInsuffStatus', t.curr_status_cd, t.tdm54_company_id, t.tdm54_reg_date) AS status_name , t.tdm54_plan_reg_emp_nm AS plan_reg_emp_name , t.tdm54_plan_action_emp_id AS plan_action_emp_id , t.tdm54_plan_action_emp_nm AS plan_action_emp_name , t.tdm54_action_emp_id AS action_emp_id , t.tdm54_action_emp_nm AS action_emp_name , TO_CHAR(t.tdm54_due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS due_date , TO_CHAR(t.tdm54_action_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS action_date , t.tdm54_action_cmnt AS action_cmnt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT tdm54_chck_insuff.* , tdm51_check_ym AS tdm54_check_ym /*발생년월*/ , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm54_plan_reg_emp_id) AS tdm54_plan_reg_emp_nm /*조치계획등록자*/ , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm54_plan_action_emp_id) AS tdm54_plan_action_emp_nm /*조치예정자*/ , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm54_action_emp_id) AS tdm54_action_emp_nm /*조치자*/ , f_org_nm(tdm54_org_id, f_today()) AS tdm54_org_nm /*부서명*/ , tdm20_role_nm AS tdm54_role_nm /*직책명*/ , CASE WHEN tdm51_check_ym = TO_CHAR(f_today(),'YYYY.MM') THEN '10' WHEN tdm54_status_cd IN ('19','20','21','25','26') THEN tdm54_status_cd ELSE '11' END AS curr_status_cd FROM tdm54_chck_insuff INNER JOIN tdm52_chck_manl ON tdm52_chck_manl_id = tdm54_chck_manl_id INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm52_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm54_role_id WHERE tdm54_chck_insuff_id = #{chckInsuffId} ) t

SELECT f_get_tdmOrg_id2(CAST(#{companyId} AS numeric), t.emp03_org_code_id, f_today()) FROM ( SELECT emp03_org_code_id FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = #{personId} AND emp03_trans_cd != '800' ORDER BY emp03_trans_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm63_chck_insuff_record ( tdm63_chck_insuff_record_id, tdm63_chck_insuff_id, tdm63_reg_date, tdm63_reg_emp_id, tdm63_content, tdm63_note, tdm63_upd_nm, tdm63_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{chckInsuffId}, CAST(#{row.regDate} AS date), #{regEmpId}, #{row.content}, #{row.note}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
